# Pavurio sounds (generated by tools/sound/make_sounds.py)

| Sound | Used for | Length |
|---|---|---|
| `tap` | any button | 90 ms |
| `select` | picking an option | 132 ms |
| `tick` | wheel and slider detents | 35 ms |
| `toggle_on` | switch on | 145 ms |
| `toggle_off` | switch off | 145 ms |
| `pop` | creating something (the jelly +) | 180 ms |
| `slide_1` | slide, first quarter | 120 ms |
| `slide_2` | slide, half way | 120 ms |
| `slide_3` | slide, almost there | 120 ms |
| `slide_done` | slide completed | 810 ms |
| `log` | a care logged | 875 ms |
| `complete` | everything done today, walk finished, Pro unlocked | 1470 ms |
| `badge` | a badge or milestone | 1440 ms |
| `save` | something saved | 510 ms |
| `undo` | undo | 320 ms |
| `delete` | something removed | 250 ms |
| `error` | something went wrong (soft, never a buzzer) | 400 ms |
| `restock` | bought / restocked | 810 ms |
| `photo` | a photo or moment kept | 680 ms |
| `walk_start` | a walk starts | 560 ms |
| `pet` | tapping the pet | 240 ms |
| `open` | a sheet opens | 180 ms |
